chunks: And it was narrated from ʿAmmār al-Sābāṭī that he said:
Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام was asked about the deceased, whether his body decays, so he said:

"Yes, until no flesh or bone remains except his clay from which he was created, for it does not decay. It remains in the grave, rounded, until he is created from it just as he was created the first time."

key_terms.أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ: the first creation, indicating the original act of creation
key_terms.الْقَبْرِ: the grave where the remains stay
key_terms.طِينَتُهُ: his original clay or earthly substance of creation

ai.seo_question: Does the body completely decay after death according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the human body decays after death until only the original clay of creation remains. That clay does not perish in the grave, and from it the human being will be created again, affirming bodily resurrection and the continuity between first creation and re-creation.
